newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan seven labour credit unions say will merge.
newsitem.headline: Japan seven labour credit unions say will merge.

text.p: Seven labour credit unions in western Japan said on Thursday that they had agreed to merge on an equal basis in October 1998.
The seven unions would set up a committee on Friday to prepare for the planned merger, they said.
Of the seven credis unions, two are located in Osaka and the rest are in Kyoto, Hyogo, Shiga, Nara and Wakayama prefectures, the unions said.
The value of deposits for the seven totalled 1.08 trillion yen, about the same as a middle-ranked regional bank.
The number of their offices stood at about 80 at the end of March, industry sources said.
